title: Edge deployment snapshot v1
description: Body of admin-only GET /deployment-snapshot. Retain the complete secret-bearing original response and its matching HTTP ETag in encrypted recovery storage. JSON conformance checks the owner OpenAPI envelope, not evidence completeness, token authenticity, freshness, authorization or snapshot coherence.

x-contract.edge_availability: Emitted by Ferrum Edge v0.9.12 at 0d917701b63ef38210c49df830f48cf0457cbc7d. Edge v0.9.13 replaces it with admin-deployment-snapshot v2 and rejects v0.9.12 deployment-v1 tokens with 412.

provenance.note: Transcribed OpenAPI envelope, required members and open object shapes. The token pattern uses an absolute end assertion to match the exact parse_request implementation, which rejects trailing control bytes. Nested resource and raw evidence shapes are intentionally not narrowed beyond the owner OpenAPI.
Source of full gzip spec_content and optional external_ref_snapshot/external_ref_digest inspection data; the owner OpenAPI envelope intentionally leaves item properties open.
HTTP/runtime protocol and complete evidence retention are documented in docs/deployment-contracts.md.

namespace_etag.description: Exactly one original strong quoted deployment token, equal to the response ETag. Distinct from backup namespace and row tokens. Preserve verbatim; never refresh authority to retry a refused or uncertain mutation.

evidence.description: Complete typed and raw comparison representation: resources, associations, full specs, historical credentials, trust, namespace metadata and change watermark. SQL retains column_type, value_type and lossless value, including typed nulls, float bits and blob bytes. MongoDB retains documents and BSON bytes. Preserve every member; this open shape cannot certify completeness.

items.description: Full stored spec metadata, numeric gzip byte array spec_content and any external_ref_snapshot/external_ref_digest. Preserve complete bytes and ownership; this envelope does not impose a second ApiSpec schema.
